description.value:
At any point during a Desperate Action, you can do all of the following as non-actions:

  • Swap weapons, even heavy weapons.
  • Swap, enter, or exit your Fighting Stance.
  • Move up to half your movement speed, unslowed by difficult or tight terrain.

In addition, until the end of your next turn: 

  • You are proficient with all weapons.
  • You have a +2 to all Save Checks.

system.requirements: Must have a Fighter Adept Ability
